CbS6GlUniforms retains each original array beside its native slice, packs raw 32-bit values without NaN canonicalization, uploads changed arrays at trySetup HEAD, and reads native replacements back under a known legacy key. Every HashMap mutation writes through. A native-only slice has no int/float kind and the legacy view throws explicitly rather than guessing or returning the slice. CbS6GlUniformCloseMixin releases only layer-owned buffers. Samplers: 1.21.5 bindSampler put a GpuTexture in this map, while 1.21.6 puts a GpuTextureView (javap of both). CbS6GlViews is a live HashMap view: reads unwrap texture(), writes keep the current native view when it already represents that texture (including a subview round trip) and otherwise use CbTextures.view; entry/values iterators and every mutating HashMap operation write through without putting a legacy texture into the native map.
